10.desc: Deals 50% damage and applies Arcana's Concerto to your target, reducing Physical and Magical Resistance by 2% for 22 seconds, stacks to 11.

11.desc: Deals 80% damage and applies Stygian, afflicting you with a rapid DoT based on max health that stacks to 30, but also increasing Outgoing Damage and Hit Chance by 30% for 6 seconds. Stygian also prevents Arcane Shield and Safeguard from applying.

12.desc: Deals 250 - 1125% unavoidable non-critical damage based on your missing mana and applies Elysian, an HoT that stacks to 3, regenerating 4 mana per second, and increasing Outgoing Damage by 10% for 8 seconds.

13.desc: Deals 70% damage and applies Spinning Dragon to the target for 2 seconds, reducing the next hit they do to 0, and Praxis for 8 seconds, reducing dodge by 5%. Praxis prevents Spinning Dragon from applying but causes each successive hit from this skill to deal 10% more damage.

14.desc: Deals 190 - 570% unavoidable critical damage, increasing the lower your health is and healing you for a portion of the damage dealt. Applies Dauntless for 12 seconds, increasing Crit Chance by 15%, Haste by 25%, and reducing mana costs by 50%. Also applies Decay for 6 seconds, negating all non lifesteal healing you receive.

15.desc: Deals 75 - 338% damage, increasing the lower your target's HP percentage is and applies Ravenous, increasing your Outgoing Damage by 10% and Crit Chance by 25% for 10 seconds. Also applies Consumed to your target, reducing Outgoing Damage and Crit Chance by 10% + 1% per stack for 10 seconds, stacks to 20.

2.desc: Deals 200% damage and applies Spiral Carve, increasing Crit Chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

3.desc: Deals 100% damage and applies Awe Blast, reducing your target's Crit Chance and Damage Resistance by 15% for 10 seconds.

4.desc: Deals 80% damage and lifesteals for 125% base damage (before stats).

9.desc: Applies Valiance, increasing Strength, Dexterity, Intellect, Wisdom, and Endurance by 30% and Luck by 15% for 20 seconds.
